description: Net side-chain charge and basic/acidic residue counts in the PFA-DSP substrate pockets of Oca6, Siw14 and Oca1
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"research-agent"})
def af(acc):
    j=S.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/api/prediction/{acc}",timeout=90).json()[0]
    return S.get(j["pdbUrl"],timeout=90).text
def parse(p):
    a=[]
    for l in p.split("\n"):
        if l.startswith("ATOM"):
            a.append((l[12:16].strip(),l[17:20].strip(),int(l[22:26]),
                      float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54]),float(l[60:66])))
    return pd.DataFrame(a,columns=["name","res","num","x","y","z","b"])
CH={"ARG":1,"LYS":1,"HIS":0.1,"ASP":-1,"GLU":-1}
out=[]
det={}
for lab,acc,cys in [("Siw14/Oca3","P53965",214),("Oca1","P50946",168),("Oca6","Q12454",114)]:
    A=parse(af(acc))
    sg=A[(A.num==cys)&(A.name=="SG")][["x","y","z"]].values[0]
    sc=A[~A.name.isin(["N","CA","C","O"])].copy()
    sc["d"]=np.linalg.norm(sc[["x","y","z"]].values-sg,axis=1)
    per=sc.groupby(["num","res"]).d.min().reset_index()
    row={"protein":lab,"acc":acc,"cat_Cys":cys}
    for R in (10,12,15):
        p=per[per.d<=R]
        row[f"netQ_{R}A"]=round(sum(CH.get(r.res,0) for r in p.itertuples()),1)
        row[f"nBasic_{R}A"]=int(sum(1 for r in p.itertuples() if r.res in ("ARG","LYS")))
        row[f"nAcidic_{R}A"]=int(sum(1 for r in p.itertuples() if r.res in ("ASP","GLU")))
    out.append(row)
    det[lab]=per[per.d<=12].sort_values("d")
df=pd.DataFrame(out)
pd.set_option("display.width",250); pd.set_option("display.max_columns",30)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print("\nOca6 charged residues within 12 A of Cys114 SG:")
d=det["Oca6"]; print(d[d.res.isin(CH)].to_string(index=False))
print("\nSiw14 charged residues within 12 A of Cys214 SG:")
d=det["Siw14/Oca3"]; print(d[d.res.isin(CH)].to_string(index=False))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12.5,4.4))
ax=axes[0]
x=np.arange(3); labs=df.protein.tolist()
b=ax.bar(x,df.netQ_12A,color=["#4C72B0","#55A868","#C44E52"])
ax.bar_label(b,fmt="%+.1f"); ax.axhline(0,c="k",lw=0.8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labs); ax.set_ylabel("net side-chain charge within 12 A of catalytic Cys SG")
ax.set_title("Active-site electrostatics (AlphaFold models)")
ax=axes[1]
w=0.35
ax.bar(x-w/2,df.nBasic_12A,w,label="Arg+Lys",color="#4C72B0")
ax.bar(x+w/2,df.nAcidic_12A,w,label="Asp+Glu",color="#C44E52")
for i in x:
    ax.text(i-w/2,df.nBasic_12A[i]+0.1,int(df.nBasic_12A[i]),ha="center",fontsize=8)
    ax.text(i+w/2,df.nAcidic_12A[i]+0.1,int(df.nAcidic_12A[i]),ha="center",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labs); ax.set_ylabel("residues within 12 A of catalytic Cys SG")
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.set_title("Charged residue counts in the substrate pocket")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
